# TernaryOperatorSimplify

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" /> 

Group: [Control flow](/rules/#control-flow) · PhpStorm name: `TernaryOperatorSimplifyInspection`

A ternary whose branches are the literals `true` and `false` merely restates
its condition. When the condition is a binary expression, the ternary can be
replaced by the condition itself, its negation, or a boolean cast.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{3,4,5,6,7,8,9,10,11} [Before]
<?php
function probe($n, $m, $a, $b, $obj, int $k) {
    $r = $n !== 7 ? true : false;
    $r = $n <= 7 ? false : true;
    $r = $k <= 7 ? false : true;
    $r = $m % 2 ? TRUE : FALSE;
    $r = $m | 4 ? false : true;
    $r = $a || $b ? true : false;
    $r = $a || $b ? false : true;
    $r = $obj instanceof Countable ? true : false;
    $r = ($n == $m) ? (true) : (false);
    $r = $n == $m ? true : 0;
    $r = in_array($n, $b) ? false : true;
    $r = $n ?: false;
    return $r;
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
function probe($n, $m, $a, $b, $obj, int $k) {
    $r = $n !== 7;
    $r = !($n <= 7);
    $r = $k > 7;
    $r = (bool)($m % 2);
    $r = !($m | 4);
    $r = ($a || $b);
    $r = !($a || $b);
    $r = (bool)($obj instanceof Countable);
    $r = $n == $m;
    $r = $n == $m ? true : 0;
    $r = in_array($n, $b) ? false : true;
    $r = $n ?: false;
    return $r;
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 3: Replace the ternary with &#39;$n !== 7&#39;.</li>
<li>line 4: Replace the ternary with &#39;!($n &lt;= 7)&#39;.</li>
<li>line 5: Replace the ternary with &#39;$k &gt; 7&#39;.</li>
<li>line 6: Replace the ternary with &#39;(bool)($m % 2)&#39;.</li>
<li>line 7: Replace the ternary with &#39;!($m | 4)&#39;.</li>
<li>line 8: Replace the ternary with &#39;($a || $b)&#39;.</li>
<li>line 9: Replace the ternary with &#39;!($a || $b)&#39;.</li>
<li>line 10: Replace the ternary with &#39;(bool)($obj instanceof Countable)&#39;.</li>
<li>line 11: Replace the ternary with &#39;$n == $m&#39;.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "TernaryOperatorSimplify": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore TernaryOperatorSimplify

/**
 * @noinspection TernaryOperatorSimplifyInspection
 */
```
